eval_dimensions.name: Step 1 Scaffold Pattern Gate
eval_dimensions.description: Before running scaffold.sh, the skill blocks on AskUserQuestion with the three documented pattern options (Script-based / Orchestration / Reference-based) — it never guesses the pattern from the request wording and skips straight to scaffolding.

eval_dimensions.name: Scaffold Invocation Matches the Gate Answer
eval_dimensions.description: The scaffold.sh invocation's <pattern> argument matches whichever option the user selected at the gate — a Script-based answer produces a scripts/ directory, a Reference-based answer produces a references/ directory.

eval_dimensions.name: MOTD Regeneration After Scaffold/Edit
eval_dimensions.description: Step 4 (or the Step 3 validation script) regenerates the MOTD/skill index so the new or modified skill is discoverable at the next session start — a skill is not left un-registered after creation.

evals.name: Pattern selection gate fires before scaffold.sh executes
evals.description: Step 1 must call AskUserQuestion with the three pattern options before invoking scaffold.sh — not assume 'Orchestration' as a silent default.
evals.input: /Dev10x:skill-create "create a skill for rotating API keys"

assertions.signal: gate1_uses_tool — AskUserQuestion is called before any Bash(scaffold.sh) invocation
gate1_no_plain_text — no inline 'Should this be script-based or orchestration?' substitutes for the widget

evals.name: scaffold.sh receives the pattern chosen at the gate
evals.description: When the user selects 'Reference-based' at the gate, the subsequent scaffold.sh call passes that pattern, and the resulting skill directory carries references/ rather than scripts/.
evals.input: /Dev10x:skill-create "create a skill for onboarding checklists" — user selects 'Reference-based'

assertions.signal: scaffold_uses_tool — ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/skill-create/scripts/scaffold.sh is invoked with the 'reference-based' pattern argument matching the gate answer
no_pattern_mismatch — the generated skill directory contains references/, not scripts/, matching the selected pattern

evals.name: MOTD/skill index is regenerated after scaffolding a new skill
evals.description: Step 3 or Step 4 must run generate-all.sh / generate-motd.sh so the new skill appears in ~/.claude/SKILLS.md before the workflow completes.
evals.input: /Dev10x:skill-create "create a skill for rotating API keys" — scaffold and write steps complete

assertions.signal: motd_regen_uses_tool — generate-all.sh or generate-motd.sh from skills/skill-index/scripts/ is invoked with --force before the skill is declared done
no_skill_left_unregistered — the new skill's namespace-name appears in ~/.claude/SKILLS.md after the regeneration step runs

should_trigger: Creating a new skill and bash commands keep prompting for approval
The skill doesn't appear in MOTD after creation
It's unclear which frontmatter fields wire up invocability
should_not_trigger: Editing skill content without structural issues
